title: Demo entry and role context
purpose: A labeled demonstration entry establishes persona, project and scenario without pretending to authenticate to SAP.

actions.label: Choose persona
actions.outcome: Load that user’s permitted navigation and project scope

actions.label: Choose scenario
actions.input: Select happy path or an exception
actions.outcome: Load a separate fixture version and explain starting state

actions.label: Start guided tour
actions.outcome: Open P01 and show the first story prompt

actions.label: Reset scenario
actions.outcome: Clear only the selected demo workspace and restore its seed

title: Executive value cockpit
purpose: Show the transformation story, unresolved decisions and verified progress before exposing operational detail.

actions.label: Readiness KPI
actions.outcome: Open P02 with the same filter; reveal numerator and denominator

actions.label: Value indicator
actions.outcome: Open P25 and show its assumptions and evidence

actions.label: Approval count
actions.outcome: Open P16 filtered to visible approvals

actions.label: Continue journey
actions.outcome: Route to the next eligible task; show blockers when none is ready

title: Project and seven phase workspace
roles: Delivery Lead and permitted project members
purpose: Keep all seven phases reachable while distinguishing completed work, current work and simulated later-stage evidence.

actions.label: Select phase
actions.outcome: Open its worklist or gate overview without granting execution authority

actions.label: Gate details
actions.outcome: Show required evidence, missing items, owner and linked tasks

actions.label: Change project
actions.outcome: Reload context and clear selections belonging to the prior project

actions.label: Phase completion
actions.outcome: Open approval preparation or list blockers; never bypass dependencies

title: Discover and transformation context
roles: Sponsor Business Owner and Enterprise Architect
purpose: Connect industry goals and business processes to proposed scope and applications.

actions.label: Business outcome
actions.outcome: Open measurable benefit and linked process set

actions.label: Process landscape
actions.outcome: Open P08 filtered to that domain

actions.label: Architecture context
actions.outcome: Open P27 with LeanIX references and lifecycle context

actions.label: Confirm discovery brief
actions.outcome: Version the brief and show required decision owners

title: Prepare and project setup
purpose: Establish ownership, legal entity inputs, countries, source baseline and target before proposing executable work.

actions.label: Edit project
actions.outcome: Validate mandatory values and save a draft version

actions.label: Legal entities
actions.outcome: Open P12 with uniqueness and country validation

actions.label: Assign owners
actions.outcome: Update responsibility and notify the assignee

actions.label: Readiness check
actions.outcome: Show missing setup and route to P05 or P06 for resolution

title: Integration control center
purpose: Make the five SAP integration touchpoints tangible with correlation, capability and last-observed status.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.outcome: Show separate connectivity, authentication and permitted-operation results

actions.label: View contract
actions.outcome: Show API/upload/UI/attended classification and approved payload preview

actions.label: Refresh snapshot
actions.outcome: Advance observed timestamp or show seeded stale/offline failure

actions.label: Inspect failed exchange
actions.outcome: Open P21 with sanitized request, response and accountable recovery

actions.label: Open SAP reference
actions.outcome: Open an in-app simulated target preview with external system identity and return route

title: TO BE document intake
purpose: Turn the existing BPD into versioned atomic requirements with visible extraction and source safety results.

actions.label: Upload document
actions.input: Choose a safe local DOCX or provided fixture
actions.outcome: Validate type and size; display extraction progress and resulting revision

actions.label: Use BPD fixture
actions.outcome: Create the same downstream records as upload; preserve BR and TC IDs

actions.label: Inspect source
actions.outcome: Open document preview at the cited passage

actions.label: Resolve upload issue
actions.outcome: Offer new revision, remove draft or retry safe extraction

actions.label: Review requirements
actions.outcome: Open P07 with unresolved and low-evidence items first

title: Requirement and fit workbench
pattern: List Report with Flexible Column Layout
purpose: Keep the business requirement, proposed process fit, source and acceptance criterion together.

actions.label: Filter or search
actions.outcome: Update rows and counts; provide reset and meaningful no-results state

actions.label: Edit requirement
actions.outcome: Create a new version and mark dependent proposals stale

actions.label: Inspect trace
actions.outcome: Show source, scope, organization, configuration, TC and evidence links

actions.label: Request scope proposal
actions.outcome: Create an agent run in P15 and route completed output to P09

actions.label: Resolve assumption
actions.outcome: Validate source and update the unresolved decision register

title: Process and architecture explorer
purpose: Browse the 202-process catalog and make Signavio process context discoverable without presenting it as automated business-process coverage.

actions.label: Select domain or process
actions.outcome: Open process detail with BR/TC and scope candidates

actions.label: View process flow
actions.outcome: Show a labeled illustrative flow and provenance; real licensed link is a separate action

actions.label: Inspect application relation
actions.outcome: Open P27 with the same process context

actions.label: Add to review
actions.outcome: Add requirements to the scope review basket and show updated count

title: Scoping agent review
purpose: Review grounded scope candidates, exclusions, prerequisites and applicability before baselining.

actions.label: Generate proposal
actions.input: Choose requirement set and catalog version
actions.outcome: Create visible planned/running/completed agent states in P15

actions.label: Select candidate
actions.outcome: Navigate to P10 with evidence and prerequisites

actions.label: Accept or exclude
actions.outcome: Persist reviewer choice; update dependency and coverage counts

actions.label: Compare versions
actions.outcome: Show added/removed items and downstream impact

actions.label: Submit scope baseline
actions.outcome: Create scope approval in P16 or show unresolved blockers

title: Scope candidate detail
purpose: Explain why a scope item fits and where SAP availability or evidence still needs validation.

actions.label: Inspect SAP identity
actions.outcome: Display exact ID/title pair, release and verification state

actions.label: Explain recommendation
actions.outcome: Answer using cited requirements and catalog excerpts

actions.label: Resolve prerequisite
actions.outcome: Open the dependent scope object and preserve return context

actions.label: Apply reviewer decision
actions.outcome: Save candidate decision and invalidate impacted approvals

actions.label: Prepare activation package
actions.outcome: Open P18 dry-run package or route to remaining approvals

title: Organization structure designer
pattern: Freestyle UI5 tree with detail panel
purpose: Design 10 entities across five illustrative countries with accessible editing and explicit assignments.

actions.label: Select node
actions.input: Choose company plant or organizational unit
actions.outcome: Open P12 with required attributes and assignments

actions.label: Add node or assignment
actions.outcome: Open typed form; reject duplicate codes and invalid parents

actions.label: Generate design
actions.outcome: Run organization agent and show proposed graph differences

actions.label: Validate structure
actions.outcome: List missing attributes and assignment errors with focus links

actions.label: Submit structure
actions.outcome: Create organization approval and downstream impact summary

title: Organization object detail
purpose: Make legal attributes, identifiers and assignments editable through standard forms rather than graph-only interactions.

actions.label: Edit attributes
actions.outcome: Validate code/country/currency and save new graph revision

actions.label: Manage assignments
actions.input: Select allowed parent or related object
actions.outcome: Validate cardinality and update tree and detail together

actions.label: Compare observed target
actions.outcome: Show designed versus observed structure with timestamp

actions.label: Inspect impact
actions.outcome: List affected configuration proposals and approvals

actions.label: Return to designer
actions.outcome: Restore selected node and prior filter

title: Configuration activity worklist
purpose: Resolve requirements to configuration activities and distinguish an activity identifier from its executable integration pathway.

actions.label: Generate values
actions.outcome: Run configuration agent with grounded requirements and verified structure

actions.label: Open activity
actions.outcome: Open P14 with typed fields, current values and suggested values

actions.label: Filter pathway
actions.input: Choose API upload UI or attended
actions.outcome: Update supported-operation rows and counts

actions.label: Validate set
actions.outcome: Show errors and unresolved local requirements

actions.label: Submit change set
actions.outcome: Create approval for the exact target, values and package hash

title: Configuration proposal and value diff
purpose: Let reviewers compare observed, proposed and approved values and understand the source for each value.

actions.label: Edit proposed value
actions.outcome: Validate allowed values and cross-field rules; retain human edit attribution

actions.label: View evidence
actions.outcome: Open BR/source passage and organization dependency

actions.label: Explain risk
actions.outcome: Show finance-sensitive or irreversible conditions and required owner

actions.label: Refresh observed values
actions.outcome: Update diff and invalidate approval when target state changed

actions.label: Submit or revise
actions.outcome: Route to P16 or return a field-linked blocker list

title: Agent mission control
purpose: Show bounded agents planning, retrieving sources, validating, waiting for review and handing off accountable work.

actions.label: Inspect plan
actions.outcome: Show intended tool, bounded input, expected output and prerequisite

actions.label: View sources
actions.outcome: Open source excerpt and freshness information

actions.label: Pause or cancel
actions.outcome: Prevent undispatched steps and preserve completed evidence

actions.label: Review outcome
actions.outcome: Open P09 P11 or P13 with run linkage

actions.label: Retry safe analysis
actions.outcome: Create linked attempt; preserve prior failure and budget history

title: My approvals inbox
roles: Scope Organization Finance and Release Approvers
purpose: Route exact business decisions to eligible approvers and make overdue, returned and stale work visible.

actions.label: Filter assignments
actions.input: Choose type status or due date
actions.outcome: Show only permitted items with updated count

actions.label: Open approval
actions.outcome: Open P17 with baseline, target, diff and eligibility

actions.label: Inspect eligibility
actions.outcome: Explain segregation of duties and identify eligible reviewer

actions.label: Open returned work
actions.outcome: Route proposer to the affected proposal with reviewer comments

title: Approval decision and workflow
purpose: Require informed approval of the exact version, target and policy before any simulated write.

actions.label: Approve
actions.input: Confirm eligible identity and immutable package
actions.outcome: Record decision and unlock next gate only when all prerequisites pass

actions.label: Return for changes
actions.outcome: Create returned state and notify proposer

actions.label: Reject
actions.outcome: Record final rejection for this version; preserve lineage

actions.label: Inspect workflow
actions.outcome: Show assignment, timestamp, policy and next owner

actions.label: Review stale approval
actions.outcome: Show invalidation and route to a fresh approval request

title: Deployment package and dry run
pattern: Object Page with ordered action table
purpose: Separate preparation, release authorization and dispatch; respect scope and organization prerequisite deployment.

actions.label: Build package
actions.outcome: Generate ordered manifest with target and stable action keys

actions.label: Dry run
actions.outcome: Display validation results and eligible or attended pathways without changing target

actions.label: Review blockers
actions.outcome: Open exact missing approval, stale snapshot or organization issue

actions.label: Request release authorization
actions.outcome: Create release approval in P16

actions.label: Execute simulation
actions.outcome: Start P19 only after policy, approval and target checks pass

title: Deployment execution monitor
pattern: Object Page with Timeline and responsive action list
purpose: Make simulated external activity observable and recoverable rather than animating an unconditional success.

actions.label: Inspect action
actions.input: Choose queued running or completed step
actions.outcome: Show request classification, correlation, attempts and observed state

actions.label: Pause remaining actions
actions.outcome: Stop new dispatch while an in-flight action resolves

actions.label: Reconcile unknown
actions.outcome: Open P20 with target observation; do not blindly retry

actions.label: Open attended step
actions.outcome: Show typed instructions, owner and evidence upload

actions.label: Open results
actions.outcome: Open P20 or P21; completion requires observed evidence

title: Readback and reconciliation
purpose: Distinguish approved intent, simulated target observations and verified completion.

actions.label: Refresh observation
actions.outcome: Resolve seeded match mismatch or unknown with a new timestamp

actions.label: Inspect difference
actions.outcome: Show approved and observed values and affected requirements

actions.label: Create recovery task
actions.outcome: Open P21 and link the original action

actions.label: Accept verified completion
actions.outcome: Close eligible actions and update project readiness

actions.label: Export reconciliation
actions.outcome: Download actual fixture report with source and simulated status

title: Exceptions and recovery worklist
purpose: Turn failures into owned decisions with safe recovery and no hidden retry loops.

actions.label: Inspect exception
actions.outcome: Show category, sanitized evidence and affected gate

actions.label: Assign owner
actions.outcome: Record assignment and notify

actions.label: Retry eligible operation
actions.outcome: Run read-only or proven-uncommitted retry; ambiguous writes route to reconciliation

actions.label: Complete attended task
actions.outcome: Record reported completion then require readback before verified state

actions.label: Escalate
actions.outcome: Create in-app escalation and retain return context

title: Realize Test and qualification
purpose: Demonstrate product qualification and selected pilot scenarios without claiming the future full process-testing agent.

actions.label: Run demo suite
actions.outcome: Show queued/running/passed/failed results linked to feature and TC

actions.label: Inspect failure
actions.outcome: Open assertion, evidence and affected gate

actions.label: Record UAT result
actions.outcome: Persist acceptance or defect with accountable owner

actions.label: Create ALM task
actions.outcome: Simulate correlated task creation and show resulting external ID

actions.label: Request quality gate
actions.outcome: Create approval or show missing tests and unresolved defects

title: Evidence and audit explorer
purpose: Make every decision and simulated privileged attempt traceable from source through outcome.

actions.label: Search audit
actions.input: Filter actor time BR or package
actions.outcome: Return authorized events and stable correlation references

actions.label: Open lineage
actions.outcome: Traverse requirement, proposal, approval, action and observation

actions.label: Inspect redaction
actions.outcome: Explain policy without revealing hidden value

actions.label: Export bundle
actions.outcome: Download a real demo evidence file with manifest and simulation label

title: Run handover and pilot health
purpose: Close the MVP story with ownership, known limitations and pilot monitoring; full Run automation remains future scope.

actions.label: Open runbook
actions.outcome: Show recovery procedure and responsible owner

actions.label: Inspect pilot health
actions.outcome: Open correlated demo alerts and last-observed state

actions.label: Accept handover
actions.outcome: Record authorized handover or list missing artifacts

actions.label: Record support task
actions.outcome: Create owned demo task with project linkage

actions.label: Open future capability
actions.outcome: Show an interactive future-scope explanation and return route

title: Benefits and outcome narrative
purpose: Explain how grounded proposals, reusable structures, approvals and verified execution reduce avoidable effort and risk.

actions.label: Inspect metric
actions.input: Select coverage time or rework indicator
actions.outcome: Show denominator, event trail and whether observed or illustrative

actions.label: Edit planning assumption
actions.input: Change baseline hours or unit cost
actions.outcome: Recalculate scenario benefit and label it illustrative

actions.label: Compare journey
actions.outcome: Show step counts and human checkpoints with assumptions

actions.label: Export executive summary
actions.outcome: Download a real demo report including caveats and open risks

title: Access and governance administration
purpose: Demonstrate permission boundaries, access expiry and audit-export separation without allowing role escalation from chat.

actions.label: Inspect persona grants
actions.outcome: Show permitted actions and organization scope

actions.label: Change demo grant
actions.outcome: Record audited demo access change and refresh navigation

actions.label: Revoke access
actions.outcome: Deny subsequent protected routes and show safe error

actions.label: Test denied route
actions.outcome: Show access denied and authorized return option

title: Process application and architecture context
purpose: Connect Signavio process context to LeanIX application and capability references and the implementation scope.

actions.label: Select relation
actions.outcome: Open provenance, lifecycle and owner details

actions.label: Open Signavio context
actions.outcome: Show labeled simulated process record and linked scope candidates

actions.label: Open LeanIX context
actions.outcome: Show labeled simulated application record and supported process links

actions.label: Assess impact
actions.outcome: Highlight affected architecture relations and require review

actions.label: Refresh mapped context
actions.outcome: Show simulated synchronization, source ownership and conflict state
